issues_fixed.title: cur_score baseline mismatch in walk-forward mode
issues_fixed.fix: Added `cur_score = min(init_fold_scores)` and `hist[0]["score"] = cur_score` after computing init_fold_scores when use_walk_forward=True. This ensures the improvement threshold (local_best[0] > cur_score + min_improve) compares fold-min against fold-min (same scale). Without the fix, cur_score remained the full-validation score, causing walk-forward to be overly conservative.
issues_fixed.new_test: test_baseline_cur_score_uses_min_fold_in_walk_forward in tests/unit/test_rb_governor_cv_folds.py — sets up baseline with high full-val (400) but low min fold (100), candidate with lower full-val (200) but higher min fold (150); asserts walk-forward ACCEPTS the candidate. Without the fix the comparison 150 > 400+0.01 fails; with the fix 150 > 100+0.01 succeeds.
